build_audio_tower: build a Gemma3nAudioTower from audio and text config to process mel-spectrograms into text space embeddings
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the Gemma3nAudioTower with mel-spectrogram features to get projected text embeddings
create_subsample_projection: create a Gemma3nSubsampleConvProjection to downsample mel-spectrograms by 4x with conv channels and group norm
review_conformer_encoder: review the Gemma3nConformerEncoder used in the audio tower for 12-layer encoding with 4x temporal reduction
test_multimodal_embedder: test the Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder to project audio features from 1536-dim to 2048-dim text space
